parties: Sanjay Kirloskar; Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited
headline: Sanjay Kirloskar files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for Kirloskar Oil Engines
sum: Sanjay Kirloskar has submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) for Kirloskar Oil Engines Limited to the NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares or commencement of an open offer process.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure to the stock exchange when an acquirer has crossed key shareholding thresholds (typically 5% or 25%) or when an open offer is initiated. This filing by Sanjay Kirloskar for Kirloskar Oil Engines signals either a substantial acquisition or the formal commencement of a takeover bid. The disclosure document submitted to NSE is the primary regulatory filing required before any formal public announcement.
